sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Reject. Preserve the prior conditional applicability and approved/non-reduced very-long-hatch alternatives, but fix gen:ScantlingApprovalStatusShape: it is applied to the status value while declaring a property path back to nltl:scantlingApprovalStatus, so it targets the wrong node and can require a status value to contain another status property. Make the value shape constrain the value itself with sh:nodeKind sh:IRI, sh:class nltl:evidenceState, and the verified controlled-value set, then apply it from the narrowDeckStrip status property.
